label: champ_0100_chairman_01
text: Another Gym Leader defeated. Well done.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: champ_0100_chairman_02
text: Rika informed me that there was an unusual\nTrainer worth keeping an eye on.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: champ_0100_chairman_03
text: It seems she meant you. I’d guessed as much.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: champ_0100_chairman_04
text: I had the pleasure of observing your last match.\nI was impressed by the fantastic skill you showed![VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: champ_0100_chairman_05
text: If you manage to keep your momentum and\nachieve Champion Rank...[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: champ_0100_chairman_06
text: I will be very interested in inviting you to the\nPokémon League and—[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: champ_0100_rival_01
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Hey hey, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]! I’ve got my
team
all
picked out![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0100_rival_02
text: And I saw you battling the Gym Leader! You just\nkeep getting better![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0100_chairman_07
text: How good to see you again, Champion Nemona.\nIt has certainly been a while.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: champ_0100_rival_03
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Whoa! Wait! La Primera?\nWith [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0100_select_01
text: Why do you call her that?

label: champ_0100_select_02
text: Is she that important?

label: champ_0100_rival_04
text: Wait, did I forget to give you the full\nexplanation?![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0100_rival_05
text: Everyone calls Ms. Geeta “La Primera” because\nshe’s just that—she’s the real number one, even\r\nhigher than us regular Champions...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0100_rival_06
text: She’s the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Top Champion[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0100_chairman_08
text: I do indeed hold that claim. Alongside my role\nas chairwoman of the Pokémon League, that is.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: champ_0100_rival_07
text: I thought you were too busy to spend your time\nchecking in on Gyms![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0100_chairman_09
text: I’m not here to inspect the Gym. I’ve come to\nscout some rather promising young talent.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: champ_0100_rival_08
text: Whoaaa. I look away for one second and you’re\nfamous, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0100_rival_09
text: But hey—I found [VAR 0x0100(0000)] first!\c\nYou may be La Primera, but you can’t go stealing\nh[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0202)]imer from me![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0100_chairman_10
text: Haha. I suppose I’ll have to get in line.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: champ_0100_rival_10
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]That’s right! C’mon, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].
Time
for
our battle![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0100_rival_11
text: Quick, let’s gooo! The battlefield’s callin’![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0100_rival_12
text: [EMPTY 32]

label: champ_0100_chairman_11
text: One moment, please.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: champ_0100_rival_13
text: Huh? What is it?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0100_chairman_12
text: I would very much like to observe this match,\nif that is all right.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: champ_0100_rival_14
text: Oooh, haha! Totally fine by me![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0100_rival_15
text: Sounds fun, right, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0100_chairman_13
text: Thank you kindly. I’m already excited to see you\ntwo face off.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: champ_0100_chairman_14
text: Oh, there’s no need to be nervous. Just pretend\nI’m not even around.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: champ_0100_chairman_15
text: Let’s be on our way, then.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]
